## AuthorityFile

AuthorityFile maps every spelling of an author's name to one preferred heading,
so a search for either form finds the same works.

## NameVariants

NameVariants records transliterations, married names and pen names as aliases
of the preferred heading, each with a note on where it was seen.

## Conflicts

Two authors who share a name are told apart by birth year.
